prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, first-person perspective shot of a hand holding a smartphone, with the screen displaying an augmented reality (AR) app. The phone’s screen shows a live view of the ground and the user’s own feet, clad in vibrant, multicolored sneakers with blue, red, and yellow accents, and green pants. The AR interface overlays virtual shoe options at the bottom of the screen, suggesting a try-on feature. The hand holding the phone has a deep brown skin tone, and the background is a neutral, slightly textured gray pavement, softly out of focus to emphasize the phone and the shoes. The lighting is natural and diffuse, suggesting an overcast day, with no harsh shadows. The color palette is a mix of cool grays and greens, punctuated by the bold, saturated colors of the sneakers. The composition is centered and symmetrical, with the phone and feet aligned vertically, creating a sense of immersion and immediacy. The overall style is modern and realistic, with a subtle cinematic quality achieved through shallow depth of field and a slightly elevated camera angle, as if the viewer is looking down at their own feet through the phone.
